summary: Implemented prepareUpdate per the spec. Changes: Update container class added in rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py beside Query; translateUpdate in algebra.py now always returns an Update (empty-request path builds the prologue from q.prologue[0] via translatePrologue, then returns an empty algebra); evalUpdate in update.py iterates update.algebra and its docstring describes the Update container; prepareUpdate added in processor.py after prepareQuery with _original_args recorded; prepareUpdate exported from rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py; new test module test/test_sparql_prepare.py covers the required behaviors, including a no-mutation check that snapshots operation names and str(op) lines. Nothing was committed. Tests were NOT run (per instructions), and black was not run; a manual line-length check found only pre-existing long lines in algebra.py. Unverified assumption: the initial-bindings test relies on an empty WHERE clause yielding one solution carrying the initial binding.
